# ovirt_vm (Data Source)

The ovirt_vm data source returns the ID and details of a virtual machine by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the VM. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the VM. Either name or id must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster the VM belongs to.
- `comment` (String) Comment attached to the VM.
- `description` (String) Description of the VM.
- `memory` (Number) Memory of the VM in bytes.
- `status` (String) Status of the VM (e.g. up, down, etc.).
- `template_id` (String) ID of the base template for this VM.
